title: Syria Foils Hezbollah-Linked Plot to Assassinate Senior Transitional Officials
detail: Syrian security services announced they had dismantled a Hezbollah-linked cell that was in the 'final stages of readiness' to assassinate senior Syrian transitional government officials. Nationwide raids arrested at least 11 people; seized weapons included firearms, explosive devices, and grenade launchers. The operation reportedly spanned multiple Syrian governorates. The transitional government publicly attributed the plot to Hezbollah, framing it as an Iranian proxy operation aimed at destabilizing the new Syrian government and threatening the security of Syrian leadership. The disclosure represented one of the most significant security incidents since the transitional government took power in December 2024 and highlighted ongoing Iranian-aligned threats to the new order.

media.caption: Syrian authorities dismantle Hezbollah-linked cell plotting assassinations against transitional government officials
